title: A Harvest for the Choir
author: Noor Winterbourne
blurb: Xanthe Reyes, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
